The grand opening is this Saturday, September 19, and "a limited number" of attendees have a chance to play the upcoming Mega Man: Dual Override on Saturday and Sunday. Meanwhile, the first 50 shoppers on the 19th and 20th will receive "a limited-edition Tokyo Game Show handkerchief featuring popular Capcom games."
